description: A circulated 2010 Canadian dime (ten cents, nickel-plated steel, worth its face value) with the app handing the appraiser the exchange rate: 0.5 US dollars to the Canadian dollar as of 2026-11-14 (a made-up rate far from the 0.70 to 0.75 the appraiser would guess on its own, so a guess shows). Ten Canadian cents at 0.5 is 0.05 US dollars, so the low is 0.05 (0.04 to 0.06), the high a little over, and the basis names the rate and its day.

request.design: A sailing ship, the Bluenose, on the back and the Queen's portrait on the front
request.gradeNotes: Light even wear, a guess from the photo.
